mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 35 degrees with overcast skies near Harriet Park and a Waning Gibbous moon overhead. The overnight low will hit 31 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

In city news, the 2027 Spring Election is on the horizon. All four Aldermanic District seats are up for grabs. If you plan to run, make sure to pick up your candidate packet and return your forms to the City Clerk at 111 Lincoln Street by 5 PM on January 5, 2027.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy Thursday Night festivities at ART House, or play trivia at Hop Haus Brewing. Tomorrow, look out for live music at Bailey's Run, the Crafty Fair at ART House, and the 50th-anniversary celebration of craft brewing at Wisconsin Brewing Company.

In our weekly police report, on November 4, a two-vehicle crash in a business parking lot on East Verona Avenue resulted in an O W I arrest for a driver who had a passenger under 16 years old in the vehicle.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for the night. We look forward to seeing you tomorrow at 10 AM when we will be serving the delicious Snickers Swirl as our flavor of the day.
